description: This file contains functions and classes for token counting, encoding selection, and chat message management in a language model context, including token pruning and message compilation for context length management.

classes.name: LlamaEncoding
classes.description: Implementation of Encoding interface using llamaTokenizer for encoding and decoding tokens.

methods.name: encodingForModel
methods.description: Selects the appropriate encoding based on the model name, defaulting to llamaEncoding or gptEncoding.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts the number of tokens in given message content, defaulting to llama2 tokenizer.

methods.name: extractToolSequence
methods.description: Extracts and validates the user message from the end of a message array, ensuring the last message is from the user.

methods.name: pruneLinesFromTop
methods.description: Removes lines from the top of a prompt until within max token limit.

methods.name: pruneLinesFromBottom
methods.description: Removes lines from the bottom of a prompt until within max token limit.

methods.name: pruneStringFromBottom
methods.description: Truncates a prompt string from the bottom to fit within max tokens.

methods.name: pruneStringFromTop
methods.description: Truncates a prompt string from the top to fit within max tokens.

methods.name: getTokenCountingBufferSafety
methods.description: Calculates a safety buffer for token counting based on context length.

methods.name: pruneRawPromptFromTop
methods.description: Prunes a prompt from the top considering context length and tokens for completion.

methods.name: compileChatMessages
methods.description: Reconciles chat messages with available context length by pruning older messages while preserving critical conversation elements.
